association_metrics.conditional_definition: correct common association / opportunities where peer and receiver local tracks both have independent offline GT matches
association_metrics.end_to_end_definition: correct common association / all raw-GT opportunities where the peer object is present in the receiver at packet arrival (receiver-visible opportunity; raw peer targets invisible at the receiver are reported separately)
association_metrics.shared_only_definition: peer forecast rows whose target is present in receiver raw GT at arrival; this is coverage only and is not a common-target recall

1.0s.definition: matched start row -> exact frame t+h; same_gt additionally preserves offline GT match

2.0s.definition: matched start row -> exact frame t+h; same_gt additionally preserves offline GT match

3.0s.definition: matched start row -> exact frame t+h; same_gt additionally preserves offline GT match

5.0s.definition: matched start row -> exact frame t+h; same_gt additionally preserves offline GT match
